building.name: Alhambra Apartments
building.completed_conflict: This building's context statement dates the work 1914; the assessor's roll records the parcel as built 1922.

historical_record.description: Designed by James F. Dunn, a self-taught San Francisco architect best known for French Beaux Arts work with curved balconies, delicate ironwork and heavy figural ornament. Recorded as the Alhambra Apartments, in a Moorish style.
